name: DRAM 1710
title: Exploration of Acting
description: The basic elements of the acting process and related skills for those not intending to pursue professional acting careers. May be repeated for credit to a total of six credits with change of instructor, or with instructor consent. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Not open to Acting majors or students who have passed DRAM 1701. May not be taken out of sequence after passing DRAM 3710.
